question: 2025年与2026年（截至9月12日）非取消订单的平均实付金额（客单价）分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND status != 'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT '2026', ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'cancelled'
notes: Task 13 评测失败自动沉淀；供 Task 14 分析
